newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firm slightly on gains in crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm slightly on gains in crude.

text.p: NWE oil products gained slightly on Thursday after crude's late rise on the back of news that OPEC members had pledged to better respect their quota allocations, traders said.

Gasoline was firmer in a hazy market, helped up by strength on the New York exchange, with Eurograde barges heard traded at $187 a tonne. But this deal was described by one trader as a "dummy" and the real market was pegged closer to $183/185.
Gas oil also rose to match IPE pit gains made in a catch-up to the rise in benchmark Blend futures.
Fuel oil barges were untraded early, with dealers standing back to assess the effect on the market of the OPEC news. Notional levels were up slightly with July offered at $85 a tonne.
